settings.heading: A sunny little home brand for cats
settings.definition: A cat sitting tucked up with its paws hidden under its chest, like it plans to stay until the sun moves. That is the whole warmth of our name.
settings.body:
Sunny Loaf Co. picks a small number of pieces for cats who follow the sun around the house: a floor-to-ceiling cactus tree for climbing, and a raised plush sofa bed for the long nap after.

We list real sizes, describe every product honestly, and send tracking with every order. If something isn't right, email hello@sunnyloafco.com and we'll make it right.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Please allow 1–3 business days to process, then typically 5–10 business days for delivery. Shipping is free in the US on orders over $49, and you'll get tracking by email when it ships.

settings.question: How can I reach you?
settings.answer: Email hello@sunnyloafco.com and we'll reply within one business day.
